snippet.title: LEGACY EP 10 | THE SOUNDS OF INDIA | @raftaarmusic x @KRSNAOfficial
snippet.description:
The sounds of India take over the stage.

In Episode 10, the artists step onto the stage carrying more than just bars. They bring the sounds, stories and influences of the places they call home.
Each artist has the chance to represent their roots and turn their culture into a performance that is uniquely their own.

From language and local sounds to personal stories and regional identity, this round is about showing where they come from and making sure the audience hears it.
Who will bring their roots to life and leave a lasting mark on the stage?

Vaaroon Forever Lyrics :

Intro Chorus

Bandha nainon ne nainon se dora
Mohe kheenche chala moh tora
Tohe saunpa hai tan mann ye kora
Mohe thaame tu rakhna sada
My gaze is entangled to your gaze
And your love is tugging me towards you
I have surrendered my pristine self to you
Hold on to me forever

Verse 01

Vaaroon, vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Ab na jag ki hai parvaah koi
Thaam le tu mori jindagi
Tohse badh ke na koi khushi
I devote myself to you
No longer do I care for the world
Be the hands that hold my life
There’s no greater joy than you
Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Aaj saunpe hai sapne sabhi
Naina tore tijori mori
Hai mori
I devote myself to you
Today I handover all my dreams to you
Your eyes are my safe place

Chorus 01

Pheeka pheeka tha manwa ye mora
Chhoo ke toone bhara rang tora
Mele jaisa saja hai ye angana
Tohre aane se dil ka mora
My heart was so colourless n dull
Your touch filled it with (your) colours
My heart is adorned like a carnival
Ever since you came into my life

Verse 02

Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Tohse naata hai mora koi
Tu gagan main pawan hoon tori
Mori saansein bhi sab hain tori
I devote myself to you
There is a bond between us
If you are a sky, I am your wind
Every breath of mine is yours
Vaaroon vaaroon main vaaroon tori
Mohe aankho mein bhar le kahin
Tori khushiyon se dharkan mori
Hai mori
I devote myself to you
Let me dwell in your eyes somewhere
Your happiness makes my heart beat

Chorus 02

Tohse janamo ka phera hai mora
Tohri chhaaya mein mora basera
Tohre vaade pe sab kuchh luta doon
Moh pe rakhna bharosa zara
I have belonged to you across lifetimes
I reside in your shade
For your promise, I'd give my all
Have faith in me

Verse 03

Tore naaz saare utha loon, jo kahe
Ye naina more, more jaage hain sung tore
Har raat tori saja doon, jo kahe
Hain jeena mohe, mohe jeena hai sung tore
I’ll fulfil all your whims, if you wish
These eyes will stay awake with you
I’ll light up all your nights, if you wish
I want to live, I want to live beside you forever

Chorus 3

Tore aage main sir ko jhuka doon
Tore sapne palak pe bitha doon
Kaala teeka main tohe laga doon
Tohe laage nazar na zara
I’d bow my head before you,
Hold your dreams gently upon my eyes
Mark you with a little ward against the evil eye
May no ill ever fall upon you

snippet.title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui – 15 Minutes Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
With blood beneath my blade, I paint new rouge upon my face,
An old friend visits, in a dream taking place.
Old faces, bygone deeds, have vanished from my sight,
Still, I remember every one, by day and through the night.
Those bound by love grow old; the righteous road runs long;
Today's notes of grace or grudge define not the final song.
Who says the Underworld is far away? 
All the better—once more I'll walk along.

Today, Game Science unveils a brand-new 15-minute gameplay trailer for Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the second title in the Black Myth series. The trailer offers a first look at the protagonist in combat, along with a glimpse of the story.

As the game is still in early development, all footage was captured in-game from a work-in-progress build running at a 21:9 aspect ratio. The final release may differ.

Official Website: https://gamesci.cn/zhongkui

ഇശ്ഖ് തുളുമ്പുന്ന ഓരോ നിമിഷങ്ങളും അദ്ദേഹം തന്റെ കവിതാ സമാഹാരത്തിലേക്കു ചേർക്കുമ്പോൾ അതിനെ ഇവിടെ ഒരുമിപ്പിച്ചു കൂട്ടുവാൻ ഞങ്ങൾ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു 
എല്ലാ പ്രവാചക പ്രേമികളുടെയും സപ്പോർട് പ്രദീക്ഷിക്കുന്നു
എന്ന്

snippet.title: You’re My Beautiful Reason ❤️ | Romantic Love Song Duet | Emotional Love Ballad
snippet.description:
You’re My Beautiful Reason is a deeply emotional romantic duet about finding the one person who makes life feel complete. ❤️

A love that brings color back to your world, gives you strength through every storm, and turns ordinary moments into memories you never want to lose.

✨ “If forever has a meaning, it’s growing old with you…”

This heartfelt male and female duet is for everyone who has found someone they want beside them through every season of life.

Perfect for romantic evenings, weddings, slow dances, anniversaries, couples, love playlists, or simply closing your eyes and thinking about the person who means everything to you.

🎧 Listen with headphones and let the music speak to your heart.

Soft Emotion Music
Music for love, memories, and the moments that stay forever. ❤️
